value.rationale: The exact, sharp 3-species orientation effect identifies when asymmetry of otherwise arbitrarily rapid demographic exchange exposes zero-mean interactions, reversing local ecological stability with a fixed interaction tensor. This is a structural boundary beyond a routine eigenvalue check, and produces an explicit feasible finite-rate example.
